planets.name: TOI-4342 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-4342 with a 10.7-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-4342 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-4342. Its orbit and size follow Parc et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
